content: Swarmpit autoredeploy is a 1-minute polling job inside swarmpit app (src/clj/swarmpit/agent.clj autoredeploy-job: compares repository digest vs latest, calls redeploy-service); it does not depend on the swarmpit/agent container (which only ships docker events + node stats to app:8080/events) nor on InfluxDB. SWARMPIT_INFLUXDB unset disables stats.
